spec.description:
Retrieve information about orders that have been closed (filled or cancelled). 50 results are returned at a time, the most recent by default. If an order's tx ID is given for `start` or `end`, the order's opening time (`opentm`) is used.

**API Key Permissions Required:** `Orders and trades - Query closed orders & trades`

trades.description: Whether or not to include trades related to position in output.

userref.description: Restrict results to the given user reference id.

cl_ord_id.description: Restrict results to the given client order id.

start.description: Starting unix timestamp or order tx ID of results (exclusive).

end.description: Ending unix timestamp or order tx ID of results (inclusive).

closetime.description: Which time to use to search.

consolidate_taker.description: Whether or not to consolidate trades by individual taker trades.

without_count.description: Whether or not to include the page count in the result (`true` is much faster for users with many closed orders).

rebase_multiplier.description: Optional parameter for viewing xstocks data. `rebased` displays in terms of underlying equity, `base` displays in terms of SPV tokens.

closed.description: Closed orders, keyed by transaction ID.

refid.description: Referral order transaction ID that created this order.

userref.description: Optional numeric client identifier associated with one or more orders.

cl_ord_id.description: Optional alphanumeric client identifier associated with the order.

status.description: Status of the order: `pending` (pending book entry), `open`, `closed`, `canceled`, or `expired`.

opentm.description: Unix timestamp of when the order was placed.

starttm.description: Unix timestamp of order start time (or 0 if not set).

expiretm.description: Unix timestamp of order end time (or 0 if not set).

close.description: Conditional close order description (if conditional close set).

time_in_force.description: Time-in-force of the order: `gtc` (good till cancelled), `ioc` (immediate or cancel), `gtd` (good till date), or `fok` (fill or kill).

limitprice.description: Triggered limit price (quote currency, when limit-based order type triggered).

trigger.description: Price signal used to trigger `stop-loss`/`take-profit`/`stop-loss-limit`/`take-profit-limit` orders. `last` is the implied trigger if this field is not set.

margin.description: Indicates if the order is funded on margin.

misc.description: Comma-delimited list of miscellaneous info: `stopped` (triggered by stop price), `touched` (triggered by touch price), `liquidated`, `partial` (partial fill), `amended` (order parameters modified).

oflags.description: Comma-delimited list of order flags: `post` (post-only, available when ordertype = limit), `fcib` (prefer fee in base currency, default if selling), `fciq` (prefer fee in quote currency, default if buying, mutually exclusive with `fcib`), `nompp` (disable Market Price Protection for market orders), `viqc` (order volumes expressed in quote currency).

trades.description: List of trade IDs related to the order (if trades info requested and data available).

sender_sub_id.description: For institutional accounts, identifies the underlying sub-account/trader for Self Trade Prevention (STP).

closetm.description: Unix timestamp of when the order was closed.

count.description: Amount of available order info matching criteria. Omitted from the response when `without_count` is `true`.

notes: This endpoint genuinely paginates -- `ofs` offsets a fixed 50-row page and `count` (total matching orders) would terminate the walk -- but this format's `pagination` block cannot state it: an item-counted `total` (rule 7) requires a declared `size` parameter to convert the count into a number of pages, and Kraken exposes no parameter to set (or otherwise learn) the page size for this endpoint, only the offset. No `pagination` block is declared, matching rule 7's guidance to say so in `notes` rather than invent one; `count` is also absent entirely when `without_count: true` is passed.
